title: Medical Debt, Inflation and Your Paycheck
description:
Michael Bordenaro links medical debt, inflation and higher Treasury yields to household money stress. We examine his collections claim against the CFPB’s Q1 2023 figure, then recap his accounts of insured patients refusing payment. His suggestions include requesting discounts, reviewing itemized bills and insurance statements, and asking about financial assistance. We explain why his lawsuit and garnishment warnings need legal context, then cover his argument about raises losing purchasing power, criticism of both parties and outlook for housing, stocks and company finances. The takeaway: explore billing options instead of ignoring the bill.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
